subject: math

hotspots.label: Minuend
hotspots.description: The minuend is the starting amount — the 8 cubes you subtract from.
hotspots.positionHint: The full row of 8 cubes on the left side of the mat.
hotspots.function: The starting number in a subtraction problem.

hotspots.label: Subtrahend
hotspots.description: The subtrahend is the amount taken away — the 3 cubes pulled into the removal tray.
hotspots.positionHint: The 3 cubes lifted off the mat and set into the small removal tray below.
hotspots.function: The number subtracted from the minuend.

hotspots.label: Difference
hotspots.description: The difference is what is left — the 5 cubes remaining on the mat.
hotspots.positionHint: The 5 cubes that stay after the removal.

hotspots.label: Jump left
hotspots.description: Subtraction on a number line is a jump to the left — from 8 back to 5.
hotspots.positionHint: The leftward arrow along the number line at the front of the mat.
hotspots.function: Shows subtraction as moving left by the subtrahend.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A calm mat holds a row of 8 cubes; 3 cubes lift into a removal tray and the rest stay, with a number line along the front edge. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (grid-blue / coral / molecular-green / amber from the Math palette). Clean, specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Remaining cubes: warm off-white (roughness ~0.5). Removed cubes: faint coral cast (roughness ~0.5) so the subtrahend reads as removed. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). Number line: thin ink-grey with warm paper label plates; left jump arrow amber (roughness ~0.45). No emissive channels anywhere — interaction highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: subtraction as 'take away' — a row of 8 cubes where a selected 3 lift into a removal tray leaving 5, plus a number line with a leftward jump arrow, plus a toggleable compare view.

GEOMETRY: Mat (thin rounded slab, ~4 wide). Minuend row: 8 unit cubes along x ≈ −1.6..1.6 at z ≈ 0. Removal tray: small recessed slab near x ≈ 0.6, z ≈ −0.5. Number line along front (y ≈ −0.15, z ≈ 0.9) with ticks 1..10 and a leftward jump arrow. Compare view: a second row of 5 cubes at z ≈ 0.6 that line up with the first 5, leaving the last 3 highlighted as 'more'.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) full row / removal state; (2) number line + left jump arrow; (3) compare view with second row.

CAMERA: head-on from +z fits mat, tray, and number line; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: MinuendRow, SubtrahendRemoved, DifferenceRow, RemovalTray, NumberLine, LeftJumpArrow, CompareRow, ExtraHighlight. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
